problem: Teams embedding coding or agent harnesses (Codex, Claude Code and others) must rebuild runtime infrastructure for sandboxes, sessions and tracing.
business_model: Usage-based managed cloud API plus open source Community Edition
product_category: Developer infrastructure for AI agent harnesses

founders.name: Kuanze Ma
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder with Richard Song in the Fondo article https://fondo.com/blog/harnessrouter-introduces-unified-harness-protoco-to-simplify-agent-integrations and on the YC launch page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Unified protocol and sandboxed execution across multiple harnesses; harnesses themselves are 2025 and 2026 products so the stated product postdates the batch.

defensibility.rationale: Open source Community Edition and a protocol that others can implement; little lock-in evidence.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not determinable for 2023 because the product launched in 2026 per Epsilla's blog; OpenRouter appeared in unrelated results.

market_need_then: Not applicable to 2023: the product concept depends on agent harnesses that emerged in 2025 and 2026. No demand evidence dated to the batch.

identity.voice_and_tone: Developer protocol and open source positioning

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name, little independent press; Product Hunt badge on site appears to point at Epsilla's listing.

outcome_analysis: HarnessRouter is listed under Summer 2023 with a three person team, but sources date the product to April 2026 from Epsilla's blog, and Fondo describes a merger with Epsilla, the founder's earlier YC S23 company. It open-sourced its protocol and Community Edition in August 2026 per a vendor press release. Outcome and funding are not established.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125k seed round (aggregator only, unverified). Fondo names Kuanze Ma as cofounder, but the YC page lists only Richard Song, so only Song is recorded. Likely the YC record reflects Epsilla's batch; relationship unconfirmed. Competitor list empty because the product has no 2023 competitive context. Completeness pass: the 125K seed from Dealroom (no date, AI-generated description) is recorded and rests on a single database. Fondo names Kuanze Ma as co-founder, so he is now recorded as a founder.
